notSetUp: This part of procurement is not switched on yet. Ask an administrator to apply the procurement update.

draft.chooseItem: Choose the item from the Material Master.
draft.needQty: The requisition needs a quantity above zero.
draft.unitPrice: Unit price must be zero or more.

receipt.receivedQty: {label}: received quantity must be a number above zero.
receipt.rejectedQty: {label}: rejected quantity must be zero or more.
receipt.rejectedOverReceived: {label}: rejected cannot be more than received.
receipt.rejectedReason: {label}: give a reason for the rejected quantity (damaged, wrong part, quality, expired).
receipt.noMaterial: {label}: this PO line has no Material Master item, so it cannot be received into stock.
receipt.nothingEntered: Enter a received quantity on at least one line.

limits.enterAmount: Enter the highest order value this role may approve, or tick "No upper limit".
limits.aboveZero: The amount must be above zero.

err.category: Choose why this is an emergency.
err.categoryNote: Describe the emergency in at least {min} characters.
err.asset: Name the affected asset number or job card.
err.downtimeHours: Downtime hours must be zero or more.
err.impact: Give the downtime hours, or describe the impact of waiting in at least {min} characters.
err.routeReason: Explain why the normal approval route could not be used (at least {min} characters).
err.estCurrency: Choose the currency of the estimated value.
err.estCurrencyMismatch: The order is in {currency}. The estimate must use the same currency; currencies are not converted.
err.country: Choose the country of the order.

f.route: Why the normal approval route could not be used

err.chooseCountry: Choose one country in the workspace header.
err.max100: Save no more than 100 items at once.
err.reference: Enter one receipt or delivery reference.
err.confirm: Confirm the item details and physical quantities.
err.qtyReceipt: {name}: enter a whole positive receipt quantity.
err.qtyCount: {name}: enter a whole count of zero or more.
err.kind: {name}: choose tyre, rim or tyre/rim accessory.
err.duplicate: {name}: this item and location are already in the count.

unit.learned: Same unit as this item already in stock.
unit.set: Supplied as a kit or set.
unit.tyre: Tyres are counted one by one.
unit.rim: Rims are counted one by one.
unit.perTin: Counted per tin or tube ({pack} each).
unit.paste: Bulk paste is weighed. Check the pack.
unit.tinNoPack: Counted per tin or tube. Pack size not stated, check it.
unit.weights: Weights are counted one by one.

reorder.noCode: No item code, so usage cannot be measured.
reorder.countryOnly: This site has not issued the item in the last 12 months; only other sites in the country have. No site rate to size levels from.
reorder.noUsage: No issues of this item in the last 12 months.
reorder.leadDefault: {days}-day default lead time (none set in Material Master)
reorder.explanation: This site used {rate} a month over the last 12 months. Critical {critical} covers the {lead}; min {min} adds half a month of safety stock; reorder {reorder} covers two months.

gap.note: {fitted} were fitted in this period but only {issued} issued from stock. Fitments are not deducted automatically: record an Issue so balances fall when tyres are used.
